profile.bioSummary: Over two years of hands-on experience in project coordination, recruitment, HR administration, and organizational operations. Skilled in structured program coordination, applicant data management, and operational workflows across organizations, internships, and campus initiatives.
profile.introHeading: Hi! Get to know me, I'm Hana.
profile.introGreeting:
A Management student at UPN "Veteran" Yogyakarta with a deep focus on Human Resources and Project Operations. My background spans candidate recruitment pipelines, applicant tracking systems, SOP standardization, and team engagement initiatives across corporate internships and campus leadership roles.

Throughout my journey, I have managed 300+ applicant and participant records, implemented structured OKR tracking frameworks, maintained rigorous HR documentation, and led cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent programs.

I am passionate about building disciplined, data-driven, and people-centered operational systems that drive organizational goals and empower individual talent.
profile.workloadPitch: Translating frontline operational discipline into strategic human resources and project execution excellence.
